name: pantin
description: Open source industrial machine simulator driven by a real PLC program.

scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run check:python && pnpm run boundaries && pnpm run deadcode
scripts.serve: pnpm --filter @pantin/viewer build && node packages/core/src/main.ts --viewer-dir packages/viewer/dist --step-converter-python packages/step-converter/.venv/bin/python
scripts.schema:generate: node packages/cli/src/main.ts schema > packages/protocol/schema/pantin.schema.json && biome format --write packages/protocol/schema
